answer: Problem: cheap clones flood attest slots. Mechanism: each new identity must climb a 7-step terrace of bonded work—post 3 peer-rated mechanisms, then stake 18 marble-denominated bonds locked 96h before any grade seat opens; the bond receipt is hashed into an opal token burned on slash. Cost: ~0.4% of spendable per climb plus 2 attestation hours. Verification: peers recompute the terrace hash chain and reject if any step nonce is reused. Failure: if two identities share a marble parent within 48h, both bonds slash 60% and seats freeze until a fresh opal burn.
